name: The world eater & Probiotic Hero Dungeon of Roguelike
detailed_description:
Embark on a quest to unravel the mysteries of a shape-shifting dungeon as you navigate its depths, enduring countless cycles of "Probiotics"!

Roguelike

"The world eater & Probiotic Hero Dungeon of Roguelike" is a casual action game with roguelike elements. Within the dungeon, cards that trigger various events are randomly placed. The monsters you encounter and the loot you obtain change with each playthrough, demanding adaptability and improvisation.

"Two-pronged Strategy"

In combat, the key is to minimize damage from enemy attacks while strategically positioning yourself for an advantageous formation within a limited time frame. Defeating enemies will reward you with amulets, items that activate under specific conditions. Equip them to craft even more intricate tactics and formations. As you progress through the dungeon, the cards you encounter will alter the protagonist's physical condition. These changes can open up previously inaccessible areas or even trigger a "Hyper Probiotics" state, a special condition that allows you to defeat enemies without engaging in combat. Your fate hinges on how you navigate the dungeon.

"Achievements"

Defeat enemies to overcome achievements and earn special bonuses. Some achievements contain fragmented information that touches upon the core secrets of this world. What awaits at the end of this dungeon? What is "Probiotics", and what is the true nature of this world? Unravel these enigmas with your own hands.
